title: Didn’t work for me, just crushed the can, but didn’t open!
text:
Didn’t work for me, just crushed the can, but didn’t open!. I , and my husband have tried to use this can Opener a few times, with out success !
All it did for me, and him was cut the can Rough, but never punctured The can to Go around it
To open it!

I have used many hand held can openers without a problem before , but not this one.
It gave instructions on the box only.
At this point I told my daughter to take it home and let me know how it works for her.
If it works, I’ll be back for a up-date.

As of now it’s a , one star.
